Inventory forecast

A simple, transparent projection based on recent monthly sales movement. It is a planning estimate, not a guarantee.

Historical sales value + 3-month outlook

Reorder watchlist

Items at or below reorder level

Forecast assumptions

Method

Monthly sales value is aggregated from the dataset, then a linear trend is extrapolated for three future months. Sparse or irregular observations may make this estimate volatile.

Inventory trigger

Reorder watch uses Quantity ≤ Reorder Level, not just the text status field, so mismatches in status labels remain visible.

Use with care

This dataset is a dated snapshot-style table; it may not represent daily stock balances or independent monthly inventory snapshots. Validate with operational context before purchasing.
